verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's documented autoscaling is Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler scaling Node Pools/bare-metal instances up/down with demand (coreweave-docs-3, coreweave-docs-16, coreweave-docs-30), and Spot/On-Demand node pools for burst capacity (coreweave-docs-4, coreweave-docs-20) — this is infrastructure-level cluster scaling, not a serverless 'deploy code and it scales to zero' abstraction. No evidence describes a serverless function/endpoint product, a scale-to-zero guarantee, or a developer simply pushing code without managing nodes/pools.
